fixes.what: Imported ../scripts/lib.mjs, ../scripts/admit.mjs and ran ../scripts/<name>.mjs; changed to ../lib.mjs, ../admit.mjs and ../<name>.mjs for the flat build layout.

tcb/test/helpers.mjs (CONTRACT 4.11) still does not exist and is not this group's file. Each test now imports helpers.mjs when it exists and otherwise uses an in-file stand-in (makeRoot, fakeTranscript, spawnSleeper, fakeProc) taken from the stand-in in lib.test.mjs, made synchronous because 4.11 gives plain return values and these tests call the helpers without await. spawnSleeper's kill() returns a promise for the child's exit.

T2 'differing e_task -> plan-differs' asserted the ledger byte-identical. The spec contradicts itself: its T2 says 'table and ledger unchanged', but its Writes section says 'incident {class: refusal} on exits 1, 5, 6', and R58 says every refusal is an incident line. Following Writes and R58, the test now asserts: table byte-identical, the old ledger bytes are an unchanged prefix, exactly one line added, which is an incident with class refusal, no second plan line, and the ledger verifies. This is stricter than before, not weaker.

Expected run/ledger.jsonl 'absent' after exit 1 plan-invalid, against the same R58 and Writes rule (the refusal appends an incident line). Now expects run/tasks.json byte-identical (its sha256) and run/ledger.jsonl present.

bind called lib.attemptOf(row, E) before checking the row's state and step, so a bind on a planned row (epoch 0, no attempts) exited 2 no-attempt instead of 65 wrong-step (fixture replace/bad-bind-wrong-step failed in selftest). The attempt is now looked up only after the step check says one must exist.
The stop sample was removed with fs.rmSync; the library now has removeFile with the Windows-sharing retries (the builder had asked for it), so stop uses lib.removeFile. Not a test failure.

still_failing: Nothing in admit.test.mjs, stop.test.mjs or replace.test.mjs fails, and the group's 14 selftest fixture cases pass. Seven tests are skipped by design as needs-app.

tcb/test/helpers.mjs still does not exist. These three tests run on their own in-file stand-in. When helpers.mjs is written, its makeRoot, fakeTranscript and spawnSleeper must be synchronous (or these tests' mk(), fakeT(), verifyWorld() must be changed to await them), otherwise the tests fail to load their roots.
notes: The builder's earlier lib requests are met by the library as it now is: ready.schema.json no longer requires schema_version; stop-sample.schema.json allows an integer target; TcbError and removeFile are exported; withRunLock passes retries on (T24 and stop T15 with lock_retries 3 give 75); currentDesign carries stpa/fmea ids (as hidden properties). The paths(root) key names were not checked against the scripts, which still spell some §2 paths with path.join.
admit spec T8 typo (e_task 1500 would be admitted by the stated rule) was already handled by the test writer with e_task 2500; spec text still says 1500.

Weak spots left as the test writer listed them: stop T12 cannot tell the in-lock re-check from the pre-check; replace T19 only shows the sentinel still exists; admit T10's gatherFacts rule (a committed card covers while f5 is false) has no script-level test.
